what: full-table completion: the five remaining compared-table columns (RefCOCO testA/testB, RefCOCO+ testA/testB, RefCOCOg test(u)) evaluated with the same frozen components and the aligned protocol
protocol: mIoU = mean per-expression IoU; oIoU = pooled intersection/union, both from the per-expression records under the aligned protocol of protocol_audit.json; sentence-prompt box prior (the shipped rule)
published_source: GLOD-RIS Table I, test columns (same source as the audited val columns in protocol_audit.json)
transcription_note: the PDF text blocks were ordered by pinning the oIoU blocks to the three audited val oIoU values (50.85 / 45.96 / 50.03), which fixes the block sequence; transcribed values are internally coherent (oIoU < mIoU on every split, testA > testB)
pareto_ledger: Scoped precisely: the shipped method (learned selector head, declared trained; 2026-10-15 component-provenance promotion) strictly exceeds the published GLOD-RIS row on 5/5 test-column mIoU values and 5/5 test-column oIoU values; the training-free realization exceeds 5/5 and 5/5 respectively and remains reported as the zero-shot reference row. Published numbers are transcribed from GLOD-RIS Table I test columns (oIoU blocks verified against the known val oIoU before transcription); our columns are aligned re-evaluations (exp161/exp159, protocol_audit.json). GLOD-RIS does not report gRefCOCO, so our gRefCOCO results are compared there against the same-class floors (PSALM ECCV 2024 Table 12: 42.0 cIoU / 43.3 gIoU; SELF1E-8B CVPR 2026 arXiv:2603.19026: 44.4 cIoU) and the run's own prior record, per the 2026-10-08 operator standard. Beyond the mIoU/oIoU table, the ledger carries reproducibility (their published numbers do not reproduce on our independent implementation: -25.7/-23.1/-20.6 mIoU vs the val columns, glodris_repro.json) and API-independence (our path is fully local). One axis is not dominated and stays declared: the gRefCOCO path adds a second frozen detector next to the VLM prior.
head_promotion_note: 2026-10-15: test columns re-evaluated under the promoted learned head (exp161, deterministic re-analysis of the same cached records); the training-free numbers are retained as training_free_mIoU/oIoU fields.
